game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on cinder bats.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read value for station 2, then display the same value without changing it. Test dataset 2: {'value': -2}; {'value': 6}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the obsidian gate from cinder bats in Fire Shrine: keep the damage meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: damage drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
